title_en: Chinese Companies (4/20): Xiaomi and the Power of Value for Money
note_en: 小米不像传统公司那样开很多实体店，而是先通过网络销售手机 uses the pattern 不(是)A，而是B, "not A, but B," to reject one option and put the real one in its place. English often says "instead" or "rather"; in Chinese, 而是 is what completes the contrast, and leaving it out makes the sentence feel unfinished.
